name: SikaRoof Geotextile
paste:
SIKAROOF® GEOTEXTILE: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaRoof® Geotextile, September 2026, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/sikaroof-geotextile.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaRoof® Geotextile where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2026, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. Bidim A12 non-woven geotextile is a permeable synthetic fabric used in civil construction, roadworks, drainage, retaining walls, landscaping, and erosion control. Its primary purpose is to separate, filter, drain, and protect soil and aggregate layers while still allowing water to pass through.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Planter boxes
    - Retaining walls
    - Extensive and Intensive roof gardens

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaRoof® Geotextile
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (September 2026, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS3706.2: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Further Documentation (p.2).
    - AS3706.3: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Further Documentation (p.2).
    - AS3706.4: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Further Documentation (p.2).
    - AS3706.7: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Further Documentation (p.2).
    - AS3706.9: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Further Documentation (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. Bidim nonwoven geotextiles provide excellent filtration, separation and cushioning properties and feature a strong three-dimensional structure with high elongation. Bidim nonwoven geotextiles also have a high melting point and high UV resistance.
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Roll Size: 1m x 50m 2m x 50m
2.6 Shelf life. There is generally no fixed "expiry date" when the product is kept in its original packaging and stored correctly. However, the manufacturer recommends minimizing exposure to sunlight, weather, and physical damage during storage. Rolls should be stored off the ground and under cover or tarpaulins
2.7 Storage conditions.
    - In storage: Keep dry, wrapped, off the ground, and out of direct sunlight. Properly stored stock can remain usable for upto 2 years.
    - After installation: Cover within 30 days maximum, preferably much sooner.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (September 2026, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 . Bidim A12 non-woven geotextile is a durable permeable fabric used to separate soil and aggregate, provide filtration and drainage, and prevent material contamination in civil, drainage, road, and landscaping applications.
4.3 Further documentation.
    | Mechanical Properties Test | Standard | Units A12 | A14 |
    | Wide Strip Tensile Strength (MD/XMD) | AS3706.2 | kN/m | 8.0 | 11.0 |
    | Wide Strip Toughness (MD/XMD) | AS3706.2 | kj/m² | 1.5 | 3.1 |
    | Grab Tensile Strength (MD/XMD) | AS3706.2 | N | 500 | 720 |
    | Trapezoidal Tear Strength (MD/XMD) | AS3706.3 | N | 200 | 300 |
    | CBR Burst Strength | AS3706.4 | N | 1,500 | 2,000 |
    | Hydraulic Properties Test | Standard | Units | A12 | A14 |
    | Pore Size (095) | AS3706.7 | µm | 130 | 110 |
    | Permittivity | AS3706.9 | s-1 | 340 | 3.20 |
    | Coefficient of Permeability | AS3706.9 | m/s x10-⁴ | 43 | 43 |
    | Flow Rate @ 100mm Head | AS3706.9 | l/m²/sec | 340 | 320 |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    The typical values published are to the best of our knowledge true and correct. The product specification may change at any time without prior notice. No warranty is expressed or implied.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (September 2026, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaRoof® Geotextile, September 2026, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/sikaroof-geotextile.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (September 2026, Version 01.01).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Other statement: The typical values published are to the best of our knowledge true and correct. The product specification may change at any time without prior notice. No warranty is expressed or implied.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
